description: Arcentry fidelity ratchet for src/iso/scene-render.test.ts: render of tests/scene.json vs tests/snapshots/reference-canvas.png (760x540, DPR 1). fidelity = 1 - (pixelmatch diffs + uncovered pixels) / relevant pixels (threshold 0.1, AA ignored; see src/visual/fidelity.ts). Runs fail below fidelity - epsilon; `pnpm visual:record` only raises the score. Lowering it is a deliberate hand edit with a reason in the PR.
